div.b: Channel states, and what each one is telling you

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 648px; height: 1px; padding-top: 929px; margin-left: 19px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #333333;
display: inline-block; font-size: 11px; font-family: Helvetica; color: #333333; line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
DRAFT The channel exists in the console; no client has connected yet.
This is the expected state between creating it and running Helm.
ONLINE The client is connected and the tunnel is live. A private target
cannot be validated until the channel reaches this state, because
validation sends a real probe through the tunnel.
OFFLINE The client has disconnected. Start with kubectl get pods -n
airs-red-teaming, then the three FQDNs, then the service account
permission.

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 664px; height: 1px; padding-top: 909px; margin-left: 717px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #00294D;
display: inline-block; font-size: 12px; font-family: Helvetica; color: #00294D; line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;
div.b: A Helm upgrade restarts the pod and interrupts running scans

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 648px; height: 1px; padding-top: 929px; margin-left: 719px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #333333;
display: inline-block; font-size: 11px; font-family: Helvetica; color: #333333; line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
Every scan traveling through this channel is cut off when the pod
restarts. An Attack Library run takes roughly five hours, so an
upgrade in the middle of one loses most of a working day.
Settle the version before scanning starts. If the engagement might
need a Custom Target Adapter later, install v1.4.0 or higher with
the sidecar already enabled, even if no adapter exists yet. Enabling
it costs one small container; enabling it later costs the scan that
was running at the time.

a.text: Text is not SVG - cannot display
